alignment.accounting: sum of training, validation, diagnostics and failed/timeout worker durations; final test separately reported as in run2.sh
alignment.trial_limit_policy: cap 1.5 * 10800 seconds, prorate remaining shared budget before concurrent dispatch
alignment.llm_reference_difference: No LLM: Optuna TPE proposes all configurations.
alignment.search_scope: Fixed SASRec hyperparameter optimization; shared settings across four datasets; no model-family search or code evolution.
alignment.execution_isolation: trusted local processes; test directory omitted from training environment, not an OS filesystem jail

tpe.common_baseline: Fresh, exact pinned sasrec_perdataset baseline; charged once and registered as trial 0.
tpe.scope: fixed SASRec family, shared hyperparameters across four categories; one independent model per category
tpe.initialization: five completed initial observations including the common baseline before model-based TPE sampling
tpe.pruning: NopPruner; preserve template early stopping and 200-epoch/200-batch ceilings
tpe.failed_trials: charge actual GPU duration and tell Optuna FAIL; never fabricate objective values
tpe.persistence: SQLite study, frozen proposals and checksummed sampler RNG state
tpe.comparison_limit: fixed SASRec HPO with matched compute/data/evaluation; LLM methods can modify training/model code, so search spaces differ

replication.reuse_policy: reuse verified input data and pinned software only; no previous models, search results or LLM feedback
